Title: Public preview: Microsoft Operations Management Suite alert notification and remediation

Body.Content: You can now easily set up custom alerts and automatically fix operational issues from the Microsoft Operations Management Suite. The alert notification and remediation feature leverages the log analytics and automation capabilities across physical and virtual machines, using Windows or Linux, in the cloud or on-premises, for seamless IT operations. This feature is now in public preview. For more information, see Microsoft Operations Management Suite.
